_comment: Provider-literal ratchet (G1). Per-file occurrence count of provider-ID references in core. May only go DOWN. Regenerate: node scripts/check-provider-literal-ratchet.mjs --write. Every counted file must have an `allowlist` entry (count, reason, owner, diesAt); the entries are authored by hand and survive --write. Delete this file and the guard when empty.

apps/app/src/components/CodexConnectionP.reason: Explicit Codex and Cursor account flows use different native login protocols; tokens remain outside conversation history.
apps/app/src/components/CodexConnectionP.diesAt: when core account capabilities provide the login presentation contract

apps/app/src/components/thread/ThreadAct.reason: Teleport is approved only for local Codex and Pi parents, not every installed provider.
apps/app/src/components/thread/ThreadAct.diesAt: when provider capabilities advertise portable native histories

apps/app/src/views/thread-detail/ThreadD.reason: Route rejected cloud starts to the correct login panel and keep Cursor reasoning fixed per session.
apps/app/src/views/thread-detail/ThreadD.diesAt: when core capabilities expose account actions and mutable session settings

apps/cli/src/commands/cloudroom.ts.reason: The cloud account command selects between the distinct native Codex and Cursor login APIs.
apps/cli/src/commands/cloudroom.ts.diesAt: when the core exposes a shared account command contract

apps/host-daemon/src/command-handlers/te.reason: Capture Codex and Pi native transcript formats, child references, and Pi startup instructions without truncating history.
apps/host-daemon/src/command-handlers/te.diesAt: when provider adapters own native history capture

apps/server/src/services/cloudroom/telep.reason: Enforce the Codex/Pi Teleport scope and translate native identities, child traces, and model selectors into the core manifest.
apps/server/src/services/cloudroom/telep.diesAt: when core portability capabilities replace explicit native-format handling

packages/host-daemon-contract/src/comman.reason: The Teleport wire contract accepts only its two implemented native transcript formats.
packages/host-daemon-contract/src/comman.diesAt: when a versioned generic native-history contract replaces the closed harness union

apps/app/src/components/promptbox/NewThr.reason: Preserve the existing Claude Code configuration hint when the VM does not advertise that harness.

apps/app/src/hooks/queries/cloudroom-que.reason: Translate Pi model selectors and Cursor provider IDs while preserving per-harness capability restrictions.
apps/app/src/hooks/queries/cloudroom-que.diesAt: when the remote model contract no longer needs this Pi-specific translation

apps/cli/src/commands/thread/spawn.ts.reason: Existing Codex default for Cloudroom-targeted CLI starts only; local provider defaults are unaffected.
apps/cli/src/commands/thread/spawn.ts.diesAt: when the Cloudroom API supplies the default harness

apps/server/src/services/cloudroom/clien.reason: Vendored canonical Cloudroom API client: wire types, default harness, and response validation.
apps/server/src/services/cloudroom/clien.diesAt: when the canonical core API client no longer requires these harness discriminators

apps/server/src/services/cloudroom/comma.reason: Cloudroom adapter translates remote model/skill requests and rejects unsupported cloud harnesses instead of falling back to local execution.
apps/server/src/services/cloudroom/comma.diesAt: when the Cloudroom wire contract no longer needs these harness-specific translations

apps/server/src/services/cloudroom/event.reason: Translate the core's Codex, Pi, Claude Code, and Cursor event payloads into the existing GUI timeline.
apps/server/src/services/cloudroom/event.diesAt: when core events no longer require harness-specific timeline translation

apps/demo-server/src/fixtures/providers..reason: demo fixtures: the demo server's static provider roster.

apps/demo-server/src/fixtures/world.ts.reason: demo fixtures: the demo world's default provider.

apps/server/src/services/threads/thread-.reason: legacy persisted data: pre-v3 codex timelines recorded the native turn id with no checkpoint; the fallback reads them.
apps/server/src/services/threads/thread-.diesAt: legacy-tool-item-backfill migration (stamps the checkpoint onto old rows)

packages/config/src/bb-app-managed-confi.reason: BUNDLED_PROVIDER_IDS: the legacy `customAcpAgents` reader refuses an agent id that shadows a bundled provider, AND `customModelProviderIdSchema` (live `customModels` config) accepts only a bundled id or an `acp-*` id, so a third-party provider cannot carry custom models today (documented DEBT in the file).
packages/config/src/bb-app-managed-confi.diesAt: the reader with LEGACY_CUSTOM_AGENTS_REMOVED_IN (0.41); the enum when customModels accepts any registered provider id

packages/scripts/src/commands/archive-co.reason: ops script for codex temp sessions: names the `codex` executable, not a provider branch.

packages/scripts/src/lib/seed-perf-fixtu.reason: perf fixture generator: seeds threads for two providers so the timeline benchmark covers both shapes.
